references.text: The same warning to guard oneself and watch one's soul so that one does not forget what the Lord has shown
Warning to guard oneself so that one does not forget the Lord's covenant and His commands
Warning not to forget the Lord who brought the people out of Egypt
Continuation of the warning that the heart may become proud and forget the Lord your God
Serious warning about the consequences if one forgets the Lord their God
Call to the soul not to forget all the Lord's good deeds
Encouragement not to forget the teaching and to keep the commandments in the heart
Warning to those who forget the Lord their God and follow empty idols
Jesus' parable about the rich farmer who forgot God in his wealth, parallel to the warning in Deuteronomy about forgetting God when one has abundance
